title: Do Not Use! Unnecessary Stop Loss Hits & High Brokerage
text:
I strongly advise against using the Swastika app for trading. The biggest issue I've faced is that the system keeps triggering premature and unnecessary stop losses. It frequently squares off trades even when the market hasn't actually hit my target SL level. This completely ruins good trade setups and causes forced losses.
To make matters worse, their brokerage charges are incredibly high compared to other standard brokers in the market today. You end up paying a premium in fees just to lose money because of their poor order execution and glitches. Save your capital and peace of mind—avoid this app and switch to a more reliable platform.

title: Save your money.
text:
I incurred a lot of loss based on their advice. I was a beginner I believed their expertise would be better than my judgement,but it was not so..and after bearing the losses I would never believe their advice ever again.

They advised me to allocate most of my funds in just one stock, which performed poorly,and because they provided me MTF on the same,I had no option but to sell it..or else put a lot more money to own the stock which I didn't have.

I believe all this could have been avoided if my funds were better distributed among various stocks and MTF was not advised.

Since I was a novice I believed them,which was a costly mistake.
